text: Assess whether the Human Rights Act 1998 has had a positive impact on the law in England and
Wales. Illustrate your answer with relevant case law. [25]

legal profession now provide the same services to the public. [25]

for the increased popularity of ADR. [25]

Using examples, assess the validity of the statement above. [25]

how effective it is in performing these functions. [25]
